title: Interactive, informative, and fun.
quote: I enjoyed learning through the Working Effectively workshop. The environment was very collaborative and the tasks which groups were given to complete were realistic and interesting. We learned about how to work with others effectively, based on their (business) needs and their personalities. I also feel that I learned a lot about myself and how to ensure that I personally work in a way which encourages my performance on an individual level too. One aspect I found particularly interesting was the discussion on the energy levels of individuals throughout the day, and how we can work around them to maximise efficiency.
author: Jocelyne Girgis
subject: Personal Efficiency
